views.title: Multi-rank 3D comparison — 1o vectors, 3×3 tensors & routing
views.yLabel: Test score under K = 8 O(3) rotations + reflections
views.caption: CPU smoke benchmark comparing multi-task 3D models under K = 8 random O(3) rotations and mirror flips. Distance-only (Uni-Mol) and 2D graph (GraphMVP) models fail to rotate 1o vectors (near-zero cosine), while YLM leads on directional vectors and 3×3 matrices. Note: on invariant 0e scalar energy MAE, YLM does not beat dedicated invariant baselines. Source: results/cpu_smoke_nov12/.
